steps: Preheat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F) and line a 20 x 20 cm baking pan with parchment paper.
Melt the coconut oil gently in a small saucepan over low heat, then remove from heat.
In a large bowl, combine the rolled oats, ground flaxseed, cinnamon, and vanilla extract.
Add the mashed banana, coconut milk, and melted coconut oil to the oat mixture.
Stir until the mixture is evenly combined and holds together when pressed.
Transfer the mixture into the prepared pan and press firmly into an even layer.
Bake for 20 to 22 minutes, until the top is golden and the edges are set.
Cool completely in the pan before lifting out using the parchment paper.
Cut into 16 bars with a sharp knife.
Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 4 days or freeze for up to 1 month.
